top_signals.title: Japan’s Earnings Surprise Analysts to Fuel Bets for Broad Rally
top_signals.summary: Japanese companies posted their largest earnings beat in five years despite soaring oil costs, fueling hopes that strong profit growth across sectors can broaden the market rally beyond AI-related trades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
